Ericsson is looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner – Early Careers (Intern & Co-op), based in Ottawa, to support intern and co-op hiring across Canada and the United States. This role is central to delivering high-quality early talent hiring outcomes through close collaboration with hiring managers, universities, and internal stakeholders.

The successful candidate will manage end-to-end recruitment for intern and co-op positions, ensuring a seamless experience for both candidates and hiring managers while maintaining compliance with Canadian and US hiring requirements. This is a full-time, experienced-level position based in Ottawa.

Manage full-cycle recruitment for intern and co-op roles across Canada and the US
Collaborate with hiring managers to define hiring needs, timelines, selection criteria, and structured interview plans
Lead intake meetings and shape recruitment strategy for early careers hiring
Source and attract early talent through university partnerships, campus programs (with a strong focus on Canadian and/or US institutions), job boards, talent platforms, and internal pipelines
Screen and assess candidates to build strong, diverse shortlists
Coordinate high-volume interview processes and deliver an excellent candidate experience
Ensure compliance with Canada and US job posting requirements, including pay transparency and sponsorship language
Partner with Talent Acquisition Operations and HR on offers, onboarding, and hiring documentation
Track and report on key recruiting metrics such as time-to-fill, conversion rates, and pipeline health
Contribute to the continuous improvement of early careers hiring programs and processes

3–6 years of recruiting experience, in-house or at an agency
Experience hiring for intern, co-op, or early careers roles
Ability to manage multiple high-volume requisitions simultaneously
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
Experience working across Canadian and/or US markets
Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g., SuccessFactors, Eightfold, SmartRecruiter)
Strong organizational and project management skills
Experience with diversity hiring or early talent pipeline development

Short-Term Variable Compensation Plan : Your pay also includes the opportunity for an annual bonus. Actual bonus payouts are based on performance of the business against the unit’s objectives, individual performance, and the individual bonus target. Certain eligibility and pro-ration rules apply.
Your Health
Ericsson offers excellent health benefits including the choice of 3 medical and dental plan options that allow an employee to select the level of coverage that suits their needs. Core level coverage is paid for fully by Ericsson.
Your Financial Security
We invest in both your short and long-term financial wellbeing. Ericsson’s Group Retirement & Savings Program offers an automatic 2% company contribution into the Pension Plan. We are looking for an energetic HR and Recruitment Specialist to take ownership of talent acquisition and help shape the HR department. Your time will be split roughly 6 0/40 between recruitment and Learning & Development . On one side, you'll own talent acquisition end-to-end — finding, attracting and hiring great people.

On the other, you'll build our L&D function from the ground up: as a growing startup we don't yet have a Learning & Development framework in place, and creating one will be your responsibility.

It's an ideal opportunity for someone who genuinely enjoys the hunt for talent and the challenge of designing development programmes from scratch — a builder who wants real ownership of both hiring and people development within a supportive, fast-moving team.

Working hours ~15:00 - 00:00 (mid-shift) Fully remote environment This opportunity is open only to candidates based in the Philippines (Manila) Key Responsibilities: Recruitment Manage the full recruitment life-cycle — from role intake and job advert writing through sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer and close.

Proactively source candidates for Finance, Procurement and Data roles across LinkedIn, JobStreet, Indeed, social media, referrals and talent-pool databases. Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements, agree candidate profiles and keep searches on track.

Screen CVs, conduct initial interviews and coordinate the interview process end-to-end for a great candidate experience. Manage offers, background checks and pre-employment requirements; keep the applicant tracking system and pipeline reports up to date.

Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs, including passive candidates.

Configure, set up and test recruitment software and systems as we build out our tooling Learning & Development (build it from the ground up) Design and build our Learning & Development framework from scratch — as a growing startup, we don't yet have one, and this is yours to own.

Develop training and development programmes across onboarding, core skills, leadership and role-specific upskilling. Assess training needs across teams and translate them into practical, scalable learning initiatives. Source, design or facilitate workshops and learning content, and measure their impact as the business grows.

Establish the foundations — competency frameworks, learning pathways and development planning — that will scale with the company. HR Deliver a smooth onboarding experience for new hires and support their first-weeks integration. Support day-to-day HR operations — employee records, contracts, HR queries and general people support.

Contribute to employer-branding and engagement activities that make us a great place to work.

Requirements Required Skills & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business or a related field - mandatory Fluent in English (verbal and written) - mandatory 2–5 years' experience in recruitment / talent acquisition, with exposure to broader HR and L&D. A proven track record of sourcing and hiring across a range of roles.

Exposure to designing or delivering L&D / training programmes — and the initiative to build a framework from scratch in a startup environment. Hands-on experience with job boards and sourcing tools popular in the Philippines. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com .
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone,﻿ and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.
The opportunity
We are seeking a Head of Talent Acquisition passionate about enabling a product-led organisation by engaging and hiring talented members across the business. Some hiring requires deep expertise, exceptional judgment, and influence. This role is for a Talent Acquisition expert who operates at comfort in a hyper growth phase, scale organisation and driving business impact.

Lead and develop the Talent Acquisition Tech & Business team (Tech, Data, Finance, People & Commercial)
Act as a senior talent advisor to leaders across the organisation
Anticipate talent needs and market risks before they surface
Design advanced sourcing strategies for hard-to-reach talent
Set and protect the hiring bar for critical roles
Influence and evolve hiring standards, processes, and guidelines
Strengthen recruiting operations and processes
Scale the TA function as the company grows.
Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid
We are mainly looking for this role to be based in Germany, preferably in our headquarters in Berlin.

Experience in high-impact talent acquisition strategies
Exceptional sourcing, assessment, and calibration skills
Strong business acumen and comfort working with senior leaders
Ability to influence without authority
A systems mindset: you improve the operating machine, not just your own output
The ability to pivot and adapt your ways of working to achieve the best outcome, in the quickest possible time!
You have a proven track record of building pipelines for both ‘active’ and ‘passive’ candidates; building rapport throughout and ultimately closing offers!
You feel comfortable in the start-up environment, with a Global footprint and a very diverse team.
Data analysis and measurement: the ability to collect, analyse, and interpret data to measure the impact of the hiring initiatives
Tools affinity, keeping our ATS updated, and maintaining accurate data.

Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.
Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.
Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.
Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com , Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.
Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

The Senior Recruiter is responsible for Service Excellence throughout the recruitment cycle. The Senior Recruiter acts as a brand ambassador for their client and partners with the hiring managers in a consultative capacity.

They are focused on delivering top talent for their hiring managers while providing proactive and timely communication on the status of the search. The Senior Recruiter is expected to stay abreast of industry and market specific information or trends that could impact the search. They will act as a mentor to Recruiters as well as other team members.

They demonstrate innovation and outside of the box thinking with their search techniques. Duties and Responsibilities
Complete a detailed job scope conversation with the hiring leader to determine position specifications.
Timely review of applicants who have applied via the applicant tracking system.
Build and deploy effective recruitment marketing campaigns specific to the job opening.
Source candidates via resume databases and networking sites using sophisticated Boolean search language.
Source candidates via social media channels and deep web sourcing techniques.
Generate targeted lists of passive candidates using member subscriptions and technologies.
Solicit and pursue referrals from business networks and/or internal referrals.
Utilize proprietary software for mobile and email campaigning to talent communities.
Use a sophisticated mix of media to connect with talent community (phone, email, campaigning, network introductions and social media).
Provide value propositions uniquely tailored to each candidate situation and interest level in the job.
Prepare candidates for interviews; providing logistical information, interview schedule, appropriate attire and expectations for follow up from the recruiter; additional counsel as needed.
Ensure all candidates are provided with timely updates concerning the status of their applications and interviews.
Throughout the process, keeps a strong pulse on the interest levels and/or concerns of top candidates.
Conduct professional and thoughtful phone interviews that are infused with industry/role specific probing questions as the conversation/interview dictates.
Navigate difficult conversations in order to gather appropriate information.
Compare candidate phone interview notes and skills assessments with requisition specifications to determine if the candidate is a match for the role.
Apply consideration for factors relative to candidate fit to team and cultural fit.
Issue skills testing as needed and evaluate results (if process dictates).
Review background and reference information (if process dictates).
Keep candidates engaged throughout process.
Continuously build talent pipeline to ensure there are multiple candidates in play at all times.
Keep hiring manager up to date on any market changes that would impact the hiring process or talent community.
Articulate a job offer and drives for candidate acceptance.
Partner with the hiring manager to ensure the offer is accepted by the candidate.
Strict adherence to all regulations (OFCCP and all other compliance standards set forth).
Demonstrate segment/practice/industry expertise.
Work to deliver a strong candidate slate for each requisition.
Provide accurate and regular reporting of recruiting activities.
Identify perceived difficulties with searches and research solutions by collaborating with leadership (and hiring manager as appropriate).
Proactively and regularly communicates the status of each search to the hiring manager.

Position Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, management, human resources or related field required. Equivalent experience may be considered. Experience: Minimum of five or more year’s results-oriented recruiting experience working in an in-house, RPO or agency setting. Exposure:
Ability to showcase niche segment or industry expertise.
Ability to employ technologies in the recruiting process that create efficiencies.
Adhere to documentation and processes for compliance.
Experience utilizing deep web sourcing techniques.

* **Copywriting & attraction :** rédiger des annonces immersives, transparentes et ciblées. Fini le jargon purement corporate : tu parles le langage de nos candidats pour te démarquer et attirer les meilleurs talents.

Tu utiliseras les données scientifiques de tes évaluations comme un levier pour convaincre tes clients de miser sur le potentiel, tout en menant les négociations (salariales, conditions) d'une main de maître.
* **Onboarding & partenariat :** Garantir un suivi administratif irréprochable (contrats, permis, certificats, etc.). Sur le terrain, tu deviens le *career partner* de tes consultants, avec ce qu'il faut de fermeté et de bienveillance pour maintenir des relations durables.

Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.
We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.
If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.
Why this role matters
We're doubling the size of Engineering, Product, and Design year-on-year, and the biggest constraint on how fast we build is how fast we hire. You'll join the Talent team as the connective tissue between EPD leadership and the best engineers in Europe — One day you’ll be running a sharp headhunting process process for a Staff Engineer and the next; pushing a high-volume inbound pipeline through with the same rigor. Both are equally important.
Attio is for people who own their role, learn quickly, are endlessly curious, and find happiness in delivering consistently brilliant outcomes that push the company forward. We love working with people who are passionate about working this way and will do whatever it takes to get things done.

Experience hiring software engineers who'd pass a tough technical bar, not just filling a requisition
Range across both ends of the funnel: targeted, hand-crafted outbound and high-volume inbound processing, without letting either slip
A real, hands-on AI-first approach to sourcing and screening — using modern tooling to work faster, not just talking about it
Time spent inside a high-growth environment where the team doubled year after year, and the process had to hold up under that pressure
Whether you've cut your teeth at a high-bar engineering recruitment agency, grown up inside a fast-scaling startup, or learned rigor at a big tech company, what matters more than your last logo is that you've done the reps — and you're ready to do a lot more of them here.

Run processes end-to-end, from screening to offer management and admin to reporting

Resourceful the best people exist; our job is finding and reaching them, however unconventional the route.

Thoughtful given our trajectory, a role at Attio will be a genuinely meaningful step for the right person, but you can't assume that its right for everyone — we understand what candidates actually want before we tell them why we're a fit.

Urrly is rebuilding recruiting for an AI-native world, and this role is for someone who wants more responsibility than a typical early-career recruiting seat. You will use AI to remove busywork, then apply the human judgment that still matters most: finding strong people, understanding what they have actually done, earning client trust, and moving searches to successful placements.
Remote, United States

The Opportunity
We are hiring a Recruiter, Client Delivery to do the hands-on work of recruiting inside a growing, profitable recruiting business. This is an associate-level role with substantial responsibility, direct coaching, and a fast path to broader search and client ownership for someone who consistently delivers.
You may already be a full-cycle recruiter in a fast-paced environment. You may also be a top-performing SDR whose outbound discipline, resilience, and peer-relative results would translate well to recruiting. We are especially interested in people who are early in their career and ready to grow quickly, but exact years of experience matter less than evidence of performance, judgment, organization, and upside.
AI has automated much of the administrative work that slows recruiting teams down. But technology does not close every gap. Searches still need someone who notices what is missing, follows up, asks better questions, documents clearly, makes sound calls, and earns trust through the details. That is where you come in.
What You Will Own
Learn each client’s business, the role, and the evidence that would make a candidate a strong fit.
Build targeted candidate pools and run consistent, thoughtful outbound outreach.
Persist through unanswered messages and difficult searches without turning people into a volume metric.
Conduct frequent candidate conversations and interviews.
Assess what candidates have actually done, communicate opportunities honestly, and document evidence, concerns, and unknowns.
Keep multiple searches moving at once by tracking owners, decisions, dates, follow-ups, and next steps.
Make sure candidates and clients are never left guessing about where things stand.
Build client trust through clear updates, useful questions, and early notice when a search needs to change course.
Use AI for research, drafting, search planning, and workflow improvement.
Check AI output, protect confidential information, and apply human judgment to every consequential decision.
Spot the work our systems do not yet handle well and help close those gaps yourself.
Help improve the recruiting process as patterns emerge across searches.
What Makes You a Strong Fit

s.h: You likely bring one of these two backgrounds
s.t:
High-outbound sales path: You have been a strong performer in an SDR, BDR, inside sales, or similar outbound-heavy role and can show results against goals, peers, quota, pipeline, meetings, or other measurable outcomes.
Recruiting path: You have full-cycle recruiting experience in a fast-paced environment. Experience managing roughly 10–15 open roles at once is valuable evidence of pace, but it is not required for candidates coming from an SDR or outbound sales background.

s.h: Across either path, we are looking for evidence that you have
s.t:
Performed near the top of your peer group, even if your career is still early.
Personally owned measurable results such as quota attainment, rankings, awards, pipeline created, placements, fill rates, or similar outcomes.
Strong organization, accurate notes, dependable follow-through, and the discipline to do repetitive work well.
Comfort with high-volume outreach and frequent interviews while treating each person with respect.
Clear writing, direct communication, curiosity, and the ability to take candid feedback.
Practical AI fluency, including examples of how you used AI to improve real work and how you verified the result.
A real desire to become excellent at recruiting and help build a business, not only occupy a seat in one.

Urrly is ambitious, direct, and detail-oriented. We believe exceptional effort, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through compound. You will work closely with experienced teammates who will coach you, give honest feedback, and expect you to take ownership as you learn.

We will discuss daily rhythm and needed overlap for candidate and client conversations early in the process so you have a clear picture of the commitment.

For someone who delivers strong results and shows sound judgment, this role offers a fast path to broader ownership across searches, candidate strategy, and client relationships.

Two or three specific results that show how you performed against goals or peers.
Context for what you personally owned versus what was handed to you.

=========================================================
Aufgabe
-------
Über Decathlon Schweiz
Seit 1976 verfolgt Decathlon eine klare Mission: "Moving People through the Wonders of Sport". Zu unserer weltweiten Familie gehören über 105’000 Teammitglieder, 2’000 Filialen in 70 Ländern und 85 Eigenmarken.
Unser Schweizer Abenteuer begann 2016\. Seither sind wir stark gewachsen: Heute zählen wir fast 1’000 Mitarbeitende in über 30 Filialen, unterstützt von 5 zentralen Bereichen (Logistik, E\-Commerce, Finanzen, HR etc.).
Zur Verstärkung unseres HR\-Teams in Spreitenbach suchen wir im Rahmen einer Nachfolge eine/n Spezialist/in Payroll \& HR\-Administration. Das HR\-Team besteht insgesamt aus 20 Personen, von denen 6 speziell für die Bereiche Administration und Payroll verantwortlich sind.
Deine Mission
Du übernahmst die eigenverantwortliche Abwicklung der Lohnbuchhaltung und HR\-Administration für rund 300 interne Mitarbeitende. Für diese suchen wir eine sehr strukturierte und dynamische Persönlichkeit, die tiefes Payroll\-Fachwissen mit einer anpackenden («hands\-on») HR\-Administration verbindet.
Deine Aufgaben
1\. HR\-Administration
* Employee Lifecycle Management: Führung der gesamten Personaladministration von A bis Z – inkl. Erstellung von Arbeitsverträgen, Vertragsänderungen, Abwicklung von Kündigungen sowie Ausstellen von Arbeitgeberbescheinigungen.
* Behörden\- \& Meldewesen: Fristgerechte und korrekte Abwicklung der Prozesse rund um Quellensteuer, Familienzulagen, Pensionskasse (BVG), AHV/EO/APG sowie Krankheits\- und Unfallmeldungen.
2\. Payroll \& Compliance
* Lohnverarbeitung: Eigenständige Durchführung des monatlichen Lohnlaufs für ca. 300 Mitarbeitende mittels Workday und Abacus.
* Datenpflege: Erfassung und Verarbeitung aller lohnrelevanten Mutationen (Eintritte, Lohnanpassungen, Austritte, variable Lohnbestandteile).
* Compliance: Sicherstellung der vollständigen Konformität mit den Schweizer gesetzlichen Vorgaben, den Sozialversicherungen (AHV, BVG, UVG etc.) und den Steuerbehörden.
3\. HR\-Projekte \& Sonderaufgaben
* Prozess\- \& Systemoptimierung: Aktive Mitarbeit an Schlüsselprojekten im HR\-Bereich (z. B. Weiterentwicklung von Workday, E\-Planning oder Einführung des digitalen Lohnnachweises).
* Flottenmanagement: Betreuung und Verwaltung der Firmenwagen\-Flotte.
Profil
------
* Fachwissen: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Schweizer Lohnbuchhaltung und Personaladministration – erworben durch eine entsprechende Ausbildung oder einschlägige Berufserfahrung.
* Affinität für Zahlen \& IT: Du bist zahlenaffin, geübt im Umgang mit IT\-Tools und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung mit Workday und Abacus.
* Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest ausserordentlich strukturiert, exakt, zuverlässig und diskret. Zudem zeichnest du dich durch eine hohe Selbstständigkeit und Eigeninitiative aus.
* Sprachen: Fliessendes Deutsch ist zwingend erforderlich. Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. Niveau B1\) runden dein Profil ab.
* Sportbegeisterung: Selbstverständlich treibst du selbst aktiv Sport und teilst unsere Leidenschaft dafür!

s.h: We’re looking for a Technical Recruiter.
s.t:
You'll hire exceptional people and help build high-performing engineering, data science, and product teams – shaping hiring decisions with data and collaborating on our tech hiring strategy.
The company
Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.
That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.
We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The Tech Talent team hires for iwoca's Tech, Analytics, and Product (TAP) functions – we own the briefs, the sourcing, the assessment, and the standards. We're a team of three, part of a broader talent team of eight, hiring across TAP (around 200 people and growing). Heads of Engineering, Data, and Product rely on us to shape hiring direction, and our work directly impacts the teams who build our products, systems, and customer experience.
We focus on high-calibre talent – people who raise the bar and improve the teams they join. Data and structure keep our hiring objective and measured, and we share knowledge and challenge each other's thinking to raise standards.
We use Ashby as our ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter and Welcome to the Jungle for sourcing, and several tech-specific job boards for advertising, with Claude as our main AI tool.

As a Technical Recruiter, you'll focus on engineering, data science, and product roles through discovery, calibration, and execution. You'll solve hiring problems from first principles, with reasoning that is defensible.
Discovery and judgement. You'll shape role briefs with hiring managers, weighing trade-offs between seniority, scope, skill mix, and what the market will realistically supply. You'll change the process when it doesn't match the role.
Sourcing and candidate standards. You'll run outbound sourcing across software engineering, data science, strategy and product, mapping the market and designing outreach that candidates actually reply to. You'll calibrate what good looks like in panel debriefs, and tune the candidate experience to the role.
Scale and measurement. You'll run a feedback loop on your own work – scoring recommendations against frameworks, tracking passthrough rates, and calibrating against downstream interviewer feedback. Each cycle sharpens your judgement. You'll build the workflows and prompts that scale you and the team, and keep Ashby accurate so colleagues can self-serve pipeline data.
Experimentation and improvement. You'll experiment with hiring methods – AI tools, outreach formats, job description iterations – and judge what's worth adopting. You'll balance this with delivering your roles.
Autonomy and growth. You'll run your roles end-to-end from day one, with the expectation of growing into a domain expert – defining what good looks like, developing hiring strategy, and advising stakeholders on high-impact decisions.

Technical hiring. You've recruited software engineers, and you can assess engineering CVs on specialism, seniority, credibility, and relevance.
Sourcing. You’ve run outbound sourcing campaigns. You build market maps, test outreach approaches, and reach candidates who wouldn't apply directly.
Judgement. You prioritise where you spend your time – which candidates, which roles, which methods. You adjust to new evidence, and you can explain your reasoning clearly.
Make stuff happen. You take initiative, keep it moving, and have a bias for action.
Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You explain complex trade-offs in plain terms.
Technical fluency. You treat tools and systems as figure-out-able, and pick up new tech fast. You use AI and judge its output critically.

Analytical mindset. You think systematically and methodically. You gather data, seek feedback, and adapt to new evidence.
Data science hiring. You've hired data scientists working on applied machine learning; probabilistic models for decision-making.
Product or strategy hiring. You've hired for product or strategy roles in tech companies where analytical thinking is central.
Privacy standards. You understand candidate data standards – GDPR, data minimisation, handling personal data. You treat candidate information as sensitive by default.

We expect to pay from £50,000 to £70,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.
The culture
At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.
We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.
The offices

s.h: We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work
s.t:
Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.
Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

## About Our Client ##
Für eine etablierte, interdisziplinäre Gesundheitsorganisation in der Schweiz, die in einem dynamischen und regulierten Umfeld tätig ist, suchen wir eine/n Lead HR Business Partnering (m/w/d). Die Organisation zeichnet sich durch Wachstum, laufende Transformationen sowie einen starken Fokus auf Qualität, Compliance und Mitarbeitende aus.
## Job Description ##
Der Lead HR Business Partner ist der führende HR-Partner für die deutschsprachige Region der Schweiz und unterstützt das Unternehmenswachstum über mehrere Portfoliogesellschaften hinweg. Die Rolle verbindet strategische HR-Führung mit einer ausgeprägten Nähe zum operativen Geschäft und stellt sicher, dass HR-Initiativen wirksam umgesetzt werden.

Sie führt ein Team von HR Business Partnern und vereint strategische HR-Beratung, Organisationsentwicklung sowie operative HR-Führung. Darüber hinaus treibt sie die Integration von Akquisitionen, organisatorische Veränderungen und People-Initiativen im Einklang mit der unternehmensweiten HR-Strategie voran.
**Zu den Hauptaufgaben gehören:**
1. **Strategisches HR Business Partnering**
* Hauptansprechpartner für das regionale Management und Beratung der Führungskräfte in Organisationsentwicklung, Leadership und Change Management.
* Leitet aus Geschäftsstrategien HR-Initiativen ab und treibt deren Umsetzung zur Förderung von Wachstum, Performance und Integration voran.
* Mitarbeit an strategischen HR-Projekten.
* Bearbeitet komplexe arbeitsrechtliche Fragestellungen und stellt die Einhaltung arbeitsrechtlicher sowie Compliance-Vorgaben sicher.
1. **Organisationsentwicklung & Integration**
* Verantwortet die HR-Integration neuer Unternehmen sowie die Umsetzung von Organisations- und Veränderungsinitiativen.
* Unterstützt Führungskräfte in den Bereichen Organisationsdesign, Talent- und Performance-Management sowie Mitarbeiterbindung.
* Fördert Talent- und Nachfolgeplanung auf regionaler Ebene.
1. **Weiterentwicklung des HR-Betriebsmodells**
* Treibt die Umsetzung des HR-Betriebsmodells voran und stärkt die Zusammenarbeit zwischen HR Business Partnern, Shared Services und dem Business.
* Entwickelt das HRBP-Team zu einem strategischen Business-Partnering-Modell weiter.
1. **Führung des HR-Teams**
* Führt, coacht und entwickelt das regionale Team der HR Business Partner.
* Fördert einen einheitlichen HR-Ansatz sowie den Austausch von Best Practices über die Region hinweg.
1. **Zusammenarbeit mit HR Operations**
* Gewährleistet eine effektive Zusammenarbeit mit dem HR Shared Service Center innerhalb des Verantwortungsbereichs
* Sicherstellung der Payroll-Prozesse bis voraussichtlich Frühjahr 2027 im Rahmen der Übergangsphase bis zur vollständigen Übergabe an das Shared Service Center, inklusive Verantwortung für die Lohnverarbeitung und den Jahresabschluss 2026 für einen der Standorte.
## The Successful Applicant ##
**Hintergrund und Erfahrung**
* Weiterbildung im Bereich HR (HR Fachausweis, Payroll Spezialist, CAS, MAS, Personalleiter) und/oder HR Studium
* Mehrjährige fundierte hands-on-Erfahrung im Schweizer HR-Umfeld als HR Generalist, HR Manager oder Head of HR, mit breitem Verständnis für operative und strategische HR-Themen inklusiv Payroll
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse des Schweizer Arbeitsrechts und der HR-Praxis.
* HR-Führungserfahrung in einer komplexen Organisation mit mehreren Gesellschaften und Standorten.
* Erfahrung in Organisationsentwicklung, Change Management sowie Unternehmens- und Kulturintegration.
* Fähigkeit, strategische HR-Themen pragmatisch und umsetzungsstark mit operativen Anforderungen zu verbinden.
* Führungserfahrung in einer regulierten, dienstleistungsorientierten Branche, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen oder in den Life Sciences.
* Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse (Region Deutschschweiz) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse; Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
**Persönliche Eigenschaften**
* Strategische und zugleich hands-on orientierte Führungspersönlichkeit.
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Beziehungskompetenz mit der Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zu verbinden.
* Souveränes Auftreten in einem dynamischen und sich wandelnden Umfeld.
* Pragmatisch, lösungsorientiert und entscheidungsstark.
* Vertrauenswürdige Persönlichkeit mit hoher Glaubwürdigkeit auf allen Organisationsebenen.
* Leidenschaft für die Entwicklung von Menschen, den Aufbau leistungsfähiger Organisationen und die Schaffung nachhaltiger Werte.
## What's on Offer ##
* Die Möglichkeit, nachhaltige Wirkung zu erzielen und die Weiterentwicklung der HR-Organisation aktiv mitzugestalten.
* Ein professionelles und kollegiales Umfeld, das Eigenverantwortung, Fachkompetenz und Engagement fördert.
* Langfristige Entwicklungs- und Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten in einem dynamischen und wachsenden Gesundheitsumfeld.
